recoveryContract.semantics: No production D1 database is currently recognized as provisioned by VELNAR's canonical readiness state. Live Cloudflare D1 resource existence was not independently queried in this readiness phase and must be verified immediately before bounded execution via Step 0 preflight. The futureExecutionRequiredOutcomes define strict acceptance criteria for future bounded execution. Cloudflare D1 Time Travel restore is destructive and is NOT authorized.

migrationAtomicitySemantics.atomicityDisclaimer: Do not assume whole-sequence transactional atomicity. If a migration step fails, fail closed, inspect d1_migrations ledger, inspect actual schema, and use retained Time Travel recovery reference if separately authorized.

rollbackPlan.failedMigrationRollback: Inspect d1_migrations; fail closed; point-in-time recovery via Cloudflare D1 Time Travel available upon separate human authorization; production DB deletion strictly prohibited

mandatoryPreCreateProviderPreflight.description: Read-only Cloudflare D1 management-plane preflight executed before database creation

caseA_zeroMatches.action: Proceed with single database creation under explicit human approval

caseB_existingMatches.action: STOP immediately. DO NOT create another database. DO NOT migrate. DO NOT bind. Return D1_PREEXISTING_RESOURCE_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION.

mandatoryPreCreateProviderPreflight.nonAssumption: The existing resource must be independently identified and reviewed before any mutation. Do NOT assume a same-name database belongs to VELNAR.

futureExecutionSequence: 0. Read-only D1 management-plane collision/existence preflight: List current Cloudflare D1 databases in target account and search for exact name velnar-production-db.
1. Require exact-name count = 0 (Case A: proceed under human approval; Case B: count >= 1 -> STOP immediately with D1_PREEXISTING_RESOURCE_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION; do not create, migrate, or bind).
2. Create exactly one production D1 database: velnar-production-db via wrangler d1 create velnar-production-db under explicit human approval.
3. Read back created database identity (UUID) from Cloudflare API response.
4. Record minimized database identity (SHA-256 digest of DB UUID) in evidence.
5. Acquire provider-supported pre-migration Time Travel bookmark / point-in-time recovery reference.
6. Inspect pre-migration user-schema state to confirm 0 user tables.
7. Apply migrations 0001 through 0008 sequentially via wrangler d1 migrations apply velnar-production-db --remote.
8. Inspect d1_migrations table state to verify exact migration version record.
9. Perform strictly read-only post-migration schema verification using table and index existence queries.
10. Retain recovery reference and document point-in-time restore procedure (destructive restore is NOT authorized).
11. STOP and hand off verified D1 database identity to Lane C / Phase 5U.3.4B.
